description: Renovate covers only what Dependabot can't: third-party images in the Kubernetes manifests under deploy/ (today the busybox init container in deploy/adsb/readsb.yaml). Dependabot keeps the Dockerfiles under images/ and the GitHub Actions.

packageRules.description: This repo's own images are placeholders in deploy/; release.yml pins them to tag@digest when it renders the manifest artifact.
